standing: DRAFT - ILLUSTRATIVE, TEST-ONLY: values of ours that make High Press Escape's knowledge gaps executable on the isolated A02 pathway (stage W4 of the A02 package, 11 November 2026). Not knowledge, not a restatement, not a design, never approved, never served: each group stands for what an approved answer of Christian's must supply, and is added to a run only by a declared TEST-ONLY treatment (ILLUSTRATIVE_CARRIERS). The register says a begin-condition referent is written only by a ruled restatement (C58), so nothing here is one. Every value is ours; none copies A01's provisional realization (its 20 m pressure reference, its placements, or any other ruling of Christian's for A01).
about: Christian's second reply received 11 November 2026 delegates "Testing legitimate configuration alternatives using clearly labeled provisional or illustrative knowledge." The groups: IL-START (one START transition, taken by a player of the team at the start end of the axis), IL-LINE (a marked line, the illustrative pressing line), IL-PLACEMENT (the other team's start placement relative to that line, re-established at every beginning of the illustrative episode), IL-ORIGIN-STATE (the origin clause as a begin condition holding while that placement holds, in place of RPC-002-02.a and 02.b on the chain's copy only), IL-PROGRESSION-TYPED (the progression referent typed to the line, in place of RPC-002-03.b on the chain's copy only), IL-CONTROL-RELATIONAL (the control clause's referent as a relational referent, one of the two third-clause alternatives). The data run one direction only (the team at the start end of the axis escapes at START): an illustration, not a design. The questions each group stands in for are Christian's: Q1 (the observable start of established coordinated pressure), Q-scope (whether the condition governs every score or only scores inside a sequence begun under it), Q-structure (symmetric GF2 or role blocks), Q2 (the pressing line), Q3 (the third clause).
